newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-ILL KJUS OUT OF ACTION FOR A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-ILL KJUS OUT OF ACTION FOR A WEEK.

text.p: Alpine skiing World Cup holder Lasse Kjus of Norway has sinusitis and will be out of action for a week at least, his team said on Monday.
The 25-year-old Norwegian missed Sunday's first downhill of the season because of the illness.
"The problem started in Breckenbridge two weeks ago. Since last Friday, Lasse has stayed in bed with fever," Norwegian team chief Lars Otto Bjornland said.

Kjus, who has returned to Norway, will miss Tuesday's slalom in Madonna di Campiglio, Italy, and two downhills in Val Gardena at the end of the week. He may be back for a giant slalom in Alta Badia on Sunday.
